title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Covers the requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in the following strength grades: Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600. Specifies nominal sizes, tolerances, chemical composition, mechanical properties (yield stress, tensile strength, elongation), bend and rebend tests, and bond properties (TMT - thermo-mechanically treated bars).
source_evidence_note: Official BIS standard specification covering high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Covers the requirements of hot-rolled medium and high tensile structural steel plates, sections (beams, channels, angles), flats, bars, etc., for use in structural work, including bolted, riveted, and welded structures. Covers grades E 250, E 275, E 300, E 350, E 410, and E 450 with sub-qualities based on impact testing.
source_evidence_note: Relevant BIS standard covering hot-rolled medium and high tensile structural steel plates, sections, flats, and bars.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete. Covers materials, workmanship, inspection and testing, general design considerations, limit state design for flexure, compression, shear and torsion, and structural members.
source_evidence_note: BIS code of practice for the general structural use and design considerations of plain and reinforced concrete.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement (OPC) for 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade cement. Specifies fineness, setting times, soundness, and compressive strengths.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying chemical and physical requirements for 33, 43, and 53 grades of ordinary Portland cement.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductors for Rated Voltages up to and including 450/750 V
scope: Specifies requirements and tests for PVC insulated single-core and multi-core electric cables and flexible cords with copper or aluminium conductors for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V for electric power and lighting in domestic and commercial installations.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying requirements and tests for PVC insulated electric cables and flexible cords for voltages up to 450/750 V.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables: Part 1 For Working Voltage up to and including 1100 V
scope: Covers requirements and tests for single-core, two-core, three-core, 3.5-core, and multi-core crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated and PVC sheathed power cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V with copper or aluminium conductors, suitable for distribution networks.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard covering requirements and tests for crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated cables for working voltages up to 1100 V.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables: Part 1 For Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Covers requirements of PVC insulated, heavy duty cables for electricity supply, working voltages up to and including 1100 V, armoured or unarmoured, with copper or aluminium conductors.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard covering requirements of PVC insulated heavy duty electric cables for voltages up to 1100 V.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings: Part 1 Steel Tubes
scope: Specifies requirements for welded (ERW) and seamless plain end or screwed and socketed steel tubes and pipes suitable for welding or screwing to pipe threads, intended for conveyance of water, non-hazardous gas, air, and steam up to nominal bore 150 mm.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying requirements for welded and seamless steel tubes and pipes for water, non-hazardous gas, air, and steam.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes of nominal diameters from 16 mm to 1000 mm intended for conveyance of water for human consumption, raw water, and general pressure water supply systems.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes for conveyance of water for human consumption.

title: Seamless or Electrically Welded Steel Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage (168.3 mm to 2540 mm Outside Diameter) — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for seamless or electrically welded (SAW/ERW) steel pipes of outside diameter ranging from 168.3 mm to 2540 mm used for conveyance of water, gas, and sewage.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard covering requirements for seamless or electrically welded steel pipes (168.3 mm to 2540 mm OD) for water, gas, and sewage.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: Covers physical and performance requirements, construction, materials, shock absorption, penetration resistance, flammability, and electrical insulation tests for industrial safety helmets for head protection against falling objects.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard covering physical, constructional, and performance requirements for industrial safety helmets.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear
scope: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear used for general purpose, including mechanical risks, slip resistance, thermal risks, ergonomic behaviour, and protective toecap impact resistance (200 Joules).
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying basic and additional requirements for safety footwear and protective toecaps.

title: General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
scope: Code of practice for the use of structural steel in general building construction. Covers limit state design, fabrication, erection, connection design (bolting, welding), design of tension and compression members, beams, and roof trusses.
source_evidence_note: BIS code of practice for general construction and limit state design in structural steel.

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning — Guidelines
scope: Provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes as per the requirements using materials commonly available. Covers ordinary, standard, and high strength concrete (M10 to M100), self-compacting concrete, and mass concrete.
source_evidence_note: BIS guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes for ordinary, standard, and high strength concrete.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for dimensions, quality, and strength of common burnt clay building bricks for masonry work. Covers brick classification based on compressive strength, water absorption, and efflorescence.
source_evidence_note: BIS standard specifying dimensions, quality, and compressive strength requirements for common burnt clay building bricks.
